title: Mechanistic Diagnostics of Spatial Lexical Bias in Multimodal Large Language Model Spatial Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2606.01914v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) remain unreliable on spatial multiple-choice questions, and their failures are often attributed to poorly attended visual information. We identify a complementary failure mode, spatial lexical bias: a spatial relation word added to the answer options can act as a lexical-semantic distractor that draws the model's decision toward that option. Using nine open-weight MLLMs, we show that this phenomenon is widespread. We then isolate diagnostic cases in which a model answers a binary spatial question correctly yet consistently chooses a newly added third spatial option, which we call binary-stable but ternary-fragile cases. translated_title: 多模态大语言模型空间推理中空间词汇偏差的机制性诊断
translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在空间选择题上仍然不可靠，其失败通常被归因于对视觉信息关注不足。我们发现了一种互补的失败模式——空间词汇偏差：在答案选项中添加一个空间关系词，会作为一种词汇-语义干扰项，将模型的决策吸引向该选项。通过对九个开源权重的MLLM进行实验，我们证明这一现象普遍存在。随后，我们分离出诊断性案例：模型能够正确回答二元空间问题，却始终选择新添加的第三个空间选项，我们将其称为“二元稳定但三元脆弱”案例。在这些案例上利用机制可解释性工具，我们发现这种失败源于语言侧而非视觉侧：视觉注意力分析和残差流探测表明，正确的空间关系在模型内部仍然可用，而不相关的……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文发现多模态大语言模型在空间选择题中存在“空间词汇偏差”这一失败模式——选项中的空间关系词会作为词汇语义干扰项误导模型决策，并通过机制可解释性分析证明这种失败源于语言侧而非视觉侧。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies "spatial lexical bias" as a widespread failure mode in MLLMs' spatial multiple-choice reasoning—where spatial relation words in answer options act as lexical-semantic distractors—and uses mechanistic interpretability to show the failure arises on the language side rather than the visual side.
